# DripTech Eco-Flow (Kenya)
> End-to-end agricultural irrigation equipment, 1/8 to 10+ acre drip & sprinkler kits, UV-stabilized HDPE dam liners (0.5mm, 0.75mm, 1.0mm), solar borehole pumping, greenhouse structures, and farm installation services across all 47 counties in Kenya.

- Website: https://www.dripstech.co.ke
- Primary Phone / WhatsApp: +254 111 409 454 / +254 723 407 849
- Secondary Phone: +254 114 575 401
- Email: info@dripstech.co.ke
- Sitemap: https://www.dripstech.co.ke/sitemap.xml
- AI Detailed Profile: https://www.dripstech.co.ke/ai-info.txt

## Core Storefront & Planning Pages
- [Complete Product Catalogue](https://www.dripstech.co.ke/products): Live KES prices, specs, instant PDF quotes, and full illustrated A4 PDF catalogue.
- [Drip & Sprinkler Irrigation Kits](https://www.dripstech.co.ke/irrigation-kits): 1/8 acre, 1/4 acre, 1/2 acre, 1 acre, and commercial acreage kits.
- [Drip Irrigation Cost Calculator](https://www.dripstech.co.ke/irrigation-cost-calculator-kenya): Interactive dripline and farm irrigation budget estimator.
- [End-to-End Engineering & Installation Services](https://www.dripstech.co.ke/services): Site survey, hydraulic CAD design, HDPE dam liner welding, solar pumping, and installation.
- [Complete Kenya Irrigation Knowledge Hub (100+ Guides)](https://www.dripstech.co.ke/irrigation-guides-kenya): All crop, price, dam liner, county, and troubleshooting guides.
